summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of KaalChakra WebAR app. All 14 backend API tests passed (100% success rate). All frontend flows tested and working: Home, Explore, Fort Detail (3D model-viewer, narration, tabs), Quiz (name-gate, questions, results), Leaderboard, Ask the King (SSE streaming chat), theme toggle, and mobile navigation. No bugs found.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/forts returns 6 forts in authored order (shivneri, torna, rajgad, pratapgad, sinhagad, raigad) with all required fields
Backend: GET /api/forts/{slug} returns single fort; 404 for unknown slug
Backend: GET /api/forts/{slug}/quiz returns questions WITHOUT correct_index/explanation
Backend: GET /api/quiz/general returns questions WITHOUT correct_index/explanation
Backend: POST /api/quiz/submit computes score/percentage/badge correctly and returns per-question details with correct_index, is_correct, explanation
Backend: POST /api/quiz/submit validates empty player_name (400) and empty answers (400)
Backend: GET /api/leaderboard returns entries sorted by percentage desc then score desc
Backend: GET /api/leaderboard supports scope=fort&fort_slug= filtering
Backend: POST /api/chat/stream streams SSE tokens (data: {delta}) and ends with data: {done:true}
Backend: POST /api/chat/stream persists user+assistant messages
Backend: GET /api/chat/{session_id}/history returns stored messages in chronological order
Backend: POST /api/chat/stream multi-turn context works within a session_id
Backend: POST /api/chat/stream validates empty message (400)
Frontend: Home page renders hero, featured forts (3 cards), features section, how it works section
Frontend: Explore gallery loads 6 fort cards with correct data-testids
Frontend: Clicking fort card opens Fort Detail page
Frontend: Fort Detail 3D model-viewer stage renders with View in AR button
Frontend: Fort Detail narration Play/Pause/Stop buttons and captions toggle work
Frontend: Fort Detail About/Timeline tabs switch correctly
Frontend: Fort Detail CTAs (Take the quiz, Ask about this fort) navigate correctly
Frontend: Quiz Start triggers name-entry dialog when no name stored
Frontend: Quiz name entry validates (min 2 chars) and stores name in localStorage
Frontend: Quiz questions render with A-D options, Next button advances
Frontend: Quiz Finish shows score/badge (Bronze for 5/8 = 62%) and answer review accordion
Frontend: Quiz result submits to backend and appears on leaderboard
Frontend: Leaderboard shows entries sorted by percentage desc then score desc (67%, 62%, 33%, 33%, 0%)
Frontend: Leaderboard displays table on desktop with rank medals (gold/silver/bronze icons for top 3)
Frontend: Ask the King loads with quick-prompt chips and empty state
Frontend: Ask the King sends message, receives streamed assistant response via SSE
Frontend: Ask the King disclaimer shown at bottom
Frontend: Theme toggle switches light/dark mode correctly
Frontend: Desktop top nav navigation works (Home, Explore, Quiz, Leaderboard, Ask the King)
Frontend: Mobile bottom nav (390x844 viewport) displays all 5 nav items and navigation works
